risk_paths.path_name: @field_validator migration breaks validators that rely on each_item
risk_paths.description: When migrating to @field_validator, code that uses the removed each_item keyword argument must be rewritten because the new decorator does not support each_item.

conditions.statement: Target version is Pydantic 2.13.0 or later, where @field_validator does not support each_item.

evidence.quote_or_summary: The new @field_validator decorator does not have the each_item keyword argument
evidence.relevance: Code using each_item with the new validator API must be rewritten.

conditions.reasoning: The unsupported keyword is documented in the 2.13.0 migration guide.

confidence_reasons: meets every high-confidence requirement

conditions.statement: Application code uses each_item with validators or is being migrated to @field_validator while still depending on per-item validation behavior.
